ky_2_warm_up_wall.blurb: A compact sandstone wall at the Motherlode in the Red River Gorge, holding thirteen sport routes. Despite the name, it is no beginner area: the climbing is concentrated in the 5.11 and 5.12 range, with a single 5.13 at the top end. The wall leans back only slightly and rewards precise, technical movement more than raw power, which sets it apart from the steep, overhanging faces elsewhere at the Motherlode. It catches sun from morning into the early afternoon, so it is a sensible pick when you want to start in light and finish before the wall goes into shade. Expect a short walk from the main lot along the left-hand trail.
ky_2_warm_up_wall.approach: From the parking lot, follow the trail system toward the Motherlode and take the left-hand fork.
